text.p: Intelligent Electronics Inc said on Friday that it has been exploring strategic alternatives for the company.

Alternatives under consideration include the possible sale of all or a portion of XLConnect stock or the distribution of such stock to Intelligent Electronics' shareholders, the sale of IE divisions, and various mergers or acquisitions.
Intelligent Electronics said it has engaged financial advisors.

Richard D. Sanford, chairman and chief executive officer said, "Our goal is to maximize shareholder value. Our board of directors believes there is a significant gap between the company's current market valuation and its inherent value.
"Accordingly, the company is exploring a variety of strategic opportunities to enable its intrinsic worth to be more accurately reflected in the marketplace."
Shares of Intelligent Electronics dropped 3-3/4 to 3-7/8 after XLConnect said it expects its fourth quarter earnings to fall short of analysts' expectations.
